title: The Houses of Europe

sourceEvidence.excerpt: The novel opens in Faido, where physician Lucía Ortega confronts a Meridian salvage system requisitioning the clinic as part of a continent-wide Tithe. Europe’s formal states have weakened, and two technological Houses now organize much of its surviving infrastructure. Meridian speaks through ownership, logistics, patrons, and extractive efficiency; Boreal offers protection through military coordination and security.
